components.name: KZG-4844 polynomial commitment (BLS12-381 pairing, trusted setup)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Equality comparisons on public blockchain hash values (block/tx/uncle/receipt/state-root/genesis hashes) for consensus integrity, chain-continuity and cache coherence, plus zero-value 'is-set' checks. No site compares a secret-keyed MAC, so the timing-leak claim is not attacker-relevant here — every compared value is public on-chain data or a local config value. Changeable here: yes, but constant-time comparison is low-value hygiene given all inputs are public.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: math/rand usage, non-security purposes only: bloom-hasher offset randomization (performance), mrand seeded FROM crypto/rand, fallback rng for non-secret subscription correlation IDs, and test data generation. Kept as the repo's non-CSPRNG usage record per inventory policy.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Avalanche secp256k1 keychain holding keys and signing Avalanche-side ownership structures in integration tests; the production signing implementation lives in the avalanchego dependency — replaceable by the avalanchego vendor, not here. Distinct from the EVM's own secp256k1 signing (ECDSA object ALG-710f61f0).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test utility that generates throwaway secp256k1 ECDSA signing keys (crypto/ecdsa.GenerateKey on go-ethereum's crypto.S256() curve with crypto/rand) for simulator/load tests. Changeable here; quantum-deadline class, not harvest class.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The EVM transaction signature primitive. Production sites: accounts/abi/bind/auth.go (keyed transactor signs deployment txs), cmd/simulator (key loading/tx generation tooling), tests/txs+utils helpers; ~45 sites are test keygen and key-typed declarations. Production ecrecover chain the collectors missed: internal/ethapi/api.go:563 crypto.SigToPub in the personal API. Implementation: libevm crypto package (github.com/ava-labs/libevm v1.13.15) with btcsuite/btcd/btcec/v2 v2.3.5 and decred/dcrd/dcr

components.name: Go crypto/tls sessions on default settings (Go 1.24.9)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The repo's entire TLS posture: Go 1.24.9 runtime defaults — post-quantum hybrid X25519MLKEM768 offered first, classical x25519 as the weak floor. No TLS endpoint is configured in first-party code, so every TLS session the tree opens runs on these defaults.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 is the EVM's consensus-critical hash (tx IDs, state roots, ABI selectors) — replaceable only by a chain fork, not by this repo; quantum-safe family (Grover square-root only), A- rating stands. 104 live sites across ABI selector/topic computation, trie key hashing (triedb/firewood, triedb/pathdb), state proofs (internal/ethapi), genesis airdrop hashing, block-sync summary IDs (plugin/evm/message), sync proofs, precompile selectors, and the node debug API.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 hashing EIP-4844 BLS12-381 KZG commitments into blob versioned hashes: production in blob-tx admission (core/txpool/validation.go:175, validateBlobSidecar) and eth API sidecar handling (internal/ethapi/transaction_args.go:369); test constants at blobpool_test.go:70 and api_test.go:1119. Grover gives only a square-root speedup; no urgent migration.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Hash provider behind the 106 in-repo Keccak-256 sites (ALG-052c24b2): ABI function selectors, event topics, tx/state hashing. FIPS 202 family, quantum-safe (Grover only).
